upstream.name: Permanently closed collateral set: WETH / wstETH / rETH
upstream.metric: 3 collateral branches; getToken(0..2) = WETH / wstETH / rETH and getToken(3) = address(0)
upstream.note: The set cannot be extended by any administrator. WETH is direct ETH exposure; wstETH imports Lido risk and rETH imports Rocket Pool risk. All three remain correlated ETH-beta rather than independent collateral classes.

upstream.name: Chainlink ETH/USD and LST rate feeds
upstream.source: deployed immutable PriceFeed configuration and internal BOLD assessment, verified 2026-09-14
upstream.note: Each branch has constructor-fixed oracle addresses and staleness thresholds with no setter. A revert, stale or zero feed permanently shuts down the affected branch rather than failing over; lastGoodPrice then supports urgent redemptions. rETH uses min(market, exchange-rate). Coinspect BOLD-05's possible cross-branch redemption halt was not established as remediated. Chainlink feed governance is outside the completed core authority walk.

downstream.name: sBOLD wrapper (material downstream)
downstream.metric: 13.1% of BOLD supply and 24.7% of Stability Pool deposits in the assessed backing payload
downstream.note: DOWNSTREAM, not collateral and not an upstream issuer dependency. sBOLD is tracked because material BOLD inventory sits behind a wrapper owner and pause surface. Those authority observations belong on axis 5 and are not priced again here; percentages are dated measurements, not timeless claims.

dependencies.note: The dependency chain is short and enumerable, but not absent. The immutable collateral set prevents governance from adding new backing counterparties; it does not remove Chainlink, Lido, Rocket Pool, ETH or the material downstream sBOLD wrapper. Live BOLD is identified by 0x6440f144b7e50D6a8439336510312d2F54beB01D, not by the case-colliding ticker.
dependencies.upstream_resolution_rule: ⚠️ EVERY upstream entry MUST carry exactly one resolution: `slug` (one asset we score), `slugs` (a set entry naming several), `terminal: true` + `kind` (never scoreable — oracle, venue, contract, authority, incentive, real-world), or `unresolved` (scoreable, no report yet = COVERAGE GAP). ⚠️ TERMINAL AND UNRESOLVED ARE DIFFERENT CLAIMS and must never be merged: terminal means nothing is missing, unresolved means a report is owed. `address` is REQUIRED wherever the ticker collides in this corpus (DUSD x4, msUSD x3, reUSD x2, USD3 x2, BOLD x2) — a ticker-keyed graph would merge Resupply's reUSD (3.5) with Re Protocol's (5.0).

downstream_basis.asserted_only_note: None — every asserted edge is reproducible from an upstream array.
downstream_basis.do_not_hand_edit: ⚠️ downstream_tracked is GENERATED. Hand-maintaining both directions is how fxsave came to list fxUSD as BOTH its upstream and its downstream — one edge recorded twice, in opposite directions. Add the edge to the UPSTREAM array of the dependent asset and re-run build.
